story.text: 해가 뉘엿뉘엿 저물 무렵, 협재해변을 따라 나란히 걸었다. 파도 소리만 조용히 우리 사이를 채웠다.
story.reading: hae-ga nwi-eot-nwi-eot jeo-mul mu-ryeop, hyeop-jae-hae-byeon-eul tta-ra na-ran-hi geol-eot-da. pa-do so-ri-man jo-yong-hi u-ri sa-i-reul chae-wot-da.
story.en: As the sun slowly sank toward the horizon, we walked side by side along Hyeopjae Beach. Only the sound of waves quietly filled the space between us.

story.text: '요즘 무슨 고민 있제. 며칠째 표정이 안 좋다.' 용우가 먼저 말을 건넸다. 캐묻지 않고 그저 옆에서 기다려 주는 눈빛이었다.
story.reading: yo-jeum mu-seun go-min it-je. myeo-chil-jjae pyo-jeong-i an jo-ta. yong-u-ga meon-jeo mal-eul geon-net-da. kae-mut-ji anh-go geu-jeo yeop-e-seo gi-da-ryeo ju-neun nun-bit-i-eot-da.
story.en: 'You've got something on your mind lately, right. Your face hasn't looked right for days.' Yongwoo spoke up first. He didn't press, just watched me with eyes that quietly waited alongside.

story.text: 결국 나는 요즘 계속 불안했던 마음들을 하나씩 꺼내 놓았다. 진로에 대한 막막함, 앞이 안 보이는 미래에 대한 두려움까지.
story.reading: gyeol-guk na-neun yo-jeum gye-sok bul-an-haet-deon ma-eum-deul-eul ha-na-ssik kkeo-nae noh-at-da. jin-lo-e dae-han mak-mak-ham, ap-i an bo-i-neun mi-rae-e dae-han du-ryeo-um-kka-ji.
story.en: In the end, I started laying out, one by one, the anxious feelings I'd been carrying — the uncertainty about my path ahead, even the fear of a future I couldn't see clearly.

story.text: '그런 거였나.' 용우가 낮게 중얼거리며 내 어깨를 가만히 토닥여 주었다. '누구나 그런 순간이 있다. 너만 그런 거 아니다.'
story.reading: geu-reon geo-yeon-na. yong-u-ga naj-ge jung-eol-geo-ri-myeo nae eo-kkae-reul ga-man-hi to-dag-yeo ju-eot-da. nu-gu-na geu-reon sun-gan-i it-da. neo-man geu-reon geo a-ni-da.
story.en: 'So that's what it was.' Yongwoo murmured quietly and gently patted my shoulder. 'Everyone has moments like this. It's not just you.'

story.text: '…사실 나도 그렇다.' 뜻밖의 고백에 놀라 쳐다보자, 용우가 바다를 향한 채 속내를 털어놓기 시작했다. '기장이라고 다 완벽해야 되는 줄 알았다. 실수하면 안 된다는 압박감, 그거 매일 느낀다.'
story.reading: sa-sil na-do geu-reo-ta. tteus-bakk-ui go-baeg-e nol-la chyeo-da-bo-ja, yong-u-ga ba-da-reul hyang-han chae sok-nae-reul teol-eo-noh-gi si-jak-haet-da. gi-jang-i-ra-go da wan-byeok-hae-ya doe-neun jul al-at-da. sil-su-ha-myeon an doen-da-neun ap-bak-gam, geu-geo mae-il neu-kkin-da.
story.en: '...Honestly, I feel the same way.' Startled by the unexpected confession, I looked at him. Facing the sea, Yongwoo began opening up about his own inner thoughts. 'I thought being a captain meant I had to be perfect. I feel that pressure of not being allowed to make a mistake — every single day.'

story.text: '…한 번도 말한 적 없다, 이런 거.' 목소리가 살짝 떨리더니, 방송처럼 또렷하던 발음이 무너지고 낯선 억양이 섞여 나왔다. '니한테는 말해도 될 것 같아서.'
story.reading: han beon-do mal-han jeog eob-da, i-reon geo. mok-so-ri-ga sal-jjak tteol-li-deo-ni, bang-song-cheo-reom tto-ryeot-ha-deon bal-eum-i mu-neo-ji-go nat-seon eog-yang-i seokk-yeo na-wat-da. ni-han-te-neun mal-hae-do doel geot gat-a-seo.
story.en: '...I've never told anyone this before.' His voice trembled slightly, and the crisp, radio-announcer diction he always kept came apart, an unfamiliar accent slipping through. 'It just felt like I could say it to you.'

story.text: '나는 니 버팀목까진 못 돼도, 옆은 지켜줄 수 있다. 그거면 됐제.' 어둑해진 바다를 함께 바라보며, 우리 사이의 거리가 조금 더 가까워진 걸 느꼈다.
story.reading: na-neun ni beot-tim-mok-kka-jin mot dwae-do, yeop-eun ji-kyeo-jul su it-da. geu-geo-myeon dwaet-je. eo-duk-hae-jin ba-da-reul ham-kke ba-ra-bo-myeo, u-ri sa-i-ui geo-ri-ga jo-geum deo ga-kka-wo-jin geol neu-kkyeot-da.
story.en: 'I might not be able to be your pillar of support, but I can stay by your side. That should be enough, right.' Gazing together at the darkening sea, I felt the distance between us had grown a little closer.

words.example_en: My mind felt uneasy thinking about the future.

words.meaning: to pat gently, to comfort with light pats
words.example_en: He gave my shoulder a gentle, comforting pat.

words.meaning: one's true inner feelings, what's really on one's mind
words.example_en: He opened up about his true feelings for the first time.

words.meaning: a sense of pressure, being under pressure
words.example_en: The pressure of not being allowed to make a mistake was immense.

words.meaning: a pillar of support, something/someone to lean on
words.example: 그는 힘든 시기의 버팀목이 되어 주었다.
words.example_reading: geu-neun him-deun si-gi-ui beot-tim-mog-i doe-eo ju-eot-da
words.example_en: He became a pillar of support during the hard times.

sentences.ko: 나는 요즘 진로 때문에 마음이 불안했다.
sentences.reading: na-neun yo-jeum jin-lo ttae-mun-e ma-eum-i bul-an-haet-da
sentences.en: I'd been feeling anxious lately because of my career path.

sentences.reading: geu-neun mal-eop-si nae eo-kkae-reul to-dag-yeo ju-eot-da
sentences.en: He silently gave my shoulder a comforting pat.
Yongwoo, too, opened up about his true feelings for the first time.

sentences.reading: geu-neun sil-su-ha-myeon an doen-da-neun ap-bak-gam-eul mae-il neu-kkyeot-da
sentences.en: He felt the pressure of not being allowed to make a mistake every day.

sentences.ko: 그는 나에게 버팀목이 되어 주겠다고 말했다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun na-e-ge beot-tim-mog-i doe-eo ju-get-da-go mal-haet-da
sentences.en: He said he would be a pillar of support for me.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 요즘 무슨 고민 있제. 며칠째 표정이 안 좋다.
turns.reading: yo-jeum mu-seun go-min it-je. myeo-chil-jjae pyo-jeong-i an jo-ta.
turns.en: You've got something on your mind lately, right. Your face hasn't looked right for days.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 티 났어? 사실 요즘 진로 때문에 마음이 좀 불안해.
turns.reading: ti nass-eo? sa-sil yo-jeum jin-lo ttae-mun-e ma-eum-i jom bul-an-hae.
turns.en: Was it that obvious? Honestly, I've been anxious about my career path lately.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.en: Talk to me. I'll listen to all of it.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 고마워. 사실 앞이 하나도 안 보여서 무서웠어.
turns.reading: go-ma-wo. sa-sil ap-i ha-na-do an bo-yeo-seo mu-seo-wot-eo.
turns.en: Thanks. Honestly, I was scared because I couldn't see the way ahead at all.

dialogues.question: 고민을 털어놓는 손님을 대하는 용우의 태도로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best describes Yongwoo's attitude toward the passenger opening up about their worries?
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 재촉하지 않고 손님이 마음을 다 털어놓을 수 있도록 끝까지 들어주는 태도를 보였습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 너도 그런 고민 있어? 항상 자신감 넘쳐 보이는데.
turns.reading: neo-do geu-reon go-min iss-eo? hang-sang ja-sin-gam neom-chyeo bo-i-neun-de.
turns.en: Do you have worries like that too? You always seem so confident.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: …사실 나도 그렇다. 기장이라고 실수하면 안 된다는 압박감, 매일 느낀다.
turns.reading: sa-sil na-do geu-reo-ta. gi-jang-i-ra-go sil-su-ha-myeon an doen-da-neun ap-bak-gam, mae-il neu-kkin-da.
turns.en: ...Honestly, I do too. The pressure of not being allowed to make a mistake because I'm a captain — I feel it every day.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: I'm hearing this for the first time. That must have been hard.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: …한 번도 말한 적 없다. 니한테는 말해도 될 것 같아서.
turns.reading: han beon-do mal-han jeog eob-da. ni-han-te-neun mal-hae-do doel geot gat-a-seo.
turns.en: ...I've never told anyone. It just felt like I could say it to you.

dialogues.question: 용우가 처음으로 자신의 속내를 털어놓은 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo opened up about his true feelings for the first time?
dialogues.correct_answer: 손님을 믿는 마음이 커서 자신도 마음을 열게 되었다
options: 손님을 믿는 마음이 커서 자신도 마음을 열게 되었다
손님이 강하게 캐물어서 어쩔 수 없었다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 손님을 향한 깊은 신뢰가 쌓였기에, 평소 누구에게도 하지 않던 자신의 속내를 처음으로 털어놓았습니다.
